_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: Nissan VR38DETT 3.8L V6 Twin-Turbo - stock configuration
status: generated, not yet calibrated (OEM turbo values estimated)
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder

profile.name: Nissan VR38DETT OEM turbo (one per bank, estimated)

application.description: Factory twin-turbo set of the R35 GT-R: one turbo per cylinder bank, parallel. Values are estimates derived from the factory output of about 545 PS, not manufacturer data.

profile.description: Nissan VR38DETT OEM turbo (estimated) - use two of them (one per bank)

compressor.flowBasis: estimated: 340 hp / 10.5 hp per lb/min; sized so that two turbos carry about 0.95 bar up to redline of the simulated VR38DETT

reference.standard: Manufacturer rating in PS as published in Nissan GT-R market specifications; rating standard (SAE/DIN/JIS) not stated, converted to mechanical hp with 1 hp = 1.01387 PS
reference.variant: R35 GT-R MY2011 production (CBA-R35 / DBA-R35), 9.0:1, 95.5 x 88.4 mm, 7000 rpm redline
reference.source: carfromjapan.com spec sheet DBA-R35 (530 PS at 6400 rpm, 612 N·m); encycarpedia.com Nissan GT-R 2011 (530 PS at 6400 rpm, 612 N·m at 3200 rpm); jbskyline.net 2011 R35 specifications (530 hp at 6400 rpm, 612 Nm at 3200 rpm, redline 7000 rpm)
reference.notes: Bore/stroke, compression and redline match the engine file. Sources label the 530 figure as PS or hp; PS is used. Earlier MY2007-2010 ratings were 473-485 hp and are not used. Nismo and GT-R50 variants not used. The attached Dynapack sheet (630 hp at the wheels, tuned car) is not a factory figure and is not used here. OEM turbo values in the stock configuration are estimates, so the factor also absorbs boost-model error.
